daily.today_energy: Your emotional radar is especially tuned in today. Trust those gut feelings—they're basically your intuition's way of texting you important updates. Channel this sensitivity into something creative or nurturing.
daily.love: If you're coupled up, your partner might need some extra reassurance today. If you're single, that vulnerability you're feeling? It's actually magnetic energy. Someone notices when you're being real.
daily.career: Your collaborative energy is strong but so is your need for depth. Don't just go through the motions—bring genuine care to your projects. Your dedication to doing things right will catch people's attention.
daily.health: Your body's asking for comfort today. Whether that's a warm drink, movement that feels good, or just extra sleep, listen to what you need. Self-care isn't indulgent; it's maintenance.

weekly.overview: This week's cosmic energy is asking you to soften your edges, Cancer. You're carrying old patterns like luggage—it's time to set some down. Trust that vulnerability isn't weakness; it's your superpower.
weekly.love: Someone's seeing you differently lately, and honestly, they might be onto something. If you're single, a genuine conversation is brewing. If coupled, reconnect over something that made you laugh together.
weekly.career: Your ideas have more weight than you think right now. Speak up in that meeting or share your vision with someone who matters. The energy supports bold honesty over playing it safe.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for gentleness this week. Whether that's stretching, longer showers, or just sleeping in—listen. Energy is tied to how you treat yourself, and you deserve that care.
